sentences.text:
Vishal Katre vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 13 September,
2024
 Neutral Citation No. 2024:Mphc-Jbp:46121
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
At Jabalpur

Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Pramod Kumar Agrawal

On The 13th Of September, 2024
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 30034 of 2024
 Vishal Katre
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
 Appearance:
Shri V.V.R. Daniel - Advocate for the applicant.
Shri P.S. Baghel - Advocate for the Objector.
Shri K.S. Baghel - Government Advocate for the respondent/S

Order 
This is the first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.568/2023 registered at Police Station - Barghat, District Seoni (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366A, 376, 376(2)(n) of IPC and section 3/4,
5L/6 of POCSO Act.
Applicant is in detention since 3/04/2024.
2. As per the prosecution story, it is alleged that applicant has committed rape with the minor prosecutrix therefore, the aforesaid offence has been registered against the applicant.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is in jail since 3/04/2024.
He has been falsely implicated.
It is submitted that at the time of incident, age of the prosecutrix was 17 years 5 months.

In the statement recorded u/s 164 of Cr.P.C. prosecutrix has stated that she herself went with the present applicant and she stayed with the applicant about six NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:46121 2 MCRC-30034-2024 months.
Charge sheet has been filed.
There is no criminal record of applicant.
The trial of the case will take considerable time.
Therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant may be released on bail pending the trial.
4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the Objector as well as State have opposed the grant of bail to the applicant.
5. Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, but without commenting on merit of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.

Consequently, bail Vishal Katre vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/166844229/
1 application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

sentences.text: 6. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
7.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
